params.caption: 🕹️ Steam review queue hits ~12 business days, indie launches slip Valve's store and build review now reportedly takes about 12 business days, over twice its usual 3–5 day target, after a surge in submissions. Rami Ismail's Australia Did It missed its Nov 10 date over a same-day controller fix, and Food Devils missed its early access launch. Valve blames volume and repeat reviews, not AI games, and now asks devs to play builds via Steam for 5+ minutes before submitting. 🕒 Nov 14, 2026 · 23:50 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto 👥 @Steam ⏳ Should Valve speed this up? React 👍 or 👎 and comment your take #Steam #Valve #IndieGames #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
